shared_elements: worked stone slab/upright surface as carrier
row of repeated arc or U-shaped forms making a horizontal band
horizontal register-like division of the surface
justification: The clearest correspondence is that both are upright stone surfaces organised into horizontal registers, each containing a band of repeated arc/U-shaped forms and angular triangular motifs. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a thin, flat incised line drawing of a single symmetrical non-figurative motif inside an arched frame, while B is a bold relief carving crowded with recognisable animals in profile and no comparable central object.
